purpose: Estimate replay-safe proof volume and producer/checker runtime before deciding the maximum auditable catalog tranche.
sampling_rule: Sixteen catalog lines rounded from an equally spaced grid spanning 1..328; four deletion labels per line formed from cyclically shifted quartile offsets 0,10,21,31.
bundle_binding: The 76-byte bundle header binds its record count, catalog SHA-256, and pair-list SHA-256.
Every record repeats its catalog line and deletion label.
Every embedded CORE2DP2 header independently repeats the input order, catalog line, deletion label, variable count, and reconstructed clause count.
The checker requires exact pair-list order, exact record count, no trailing bytes, and atomic transcript promotion only after all trees replay.

estimators.full_artifact_projection_bytes: Scale total sample bundle, producer transcript, checker transcript, and result bytes by 13776/64, then add eight bundle headers.

immutable_decision_rule: Stop without a production plan if any sample pair is SAT, LIMIT, malformed, or rejected by the independent checker.

Proceed to a full 13776-pair plan only if all 64 sample pairs are independently replayed, the conservative bundle projection is at most 268435456 bytes, the total-artifact projection is at most 536870912 bytes, and the eight-worker wall projection is at most 1800 seconds.
Before production, require free disk to exceed max(3221225472 bytes, ten times the projected total persistent artifact bytes).
If a proceed threshold fails, preregister only the largest whole contiguous 41-line shard prefix whose conservative projections fit every threshold.

Any future SAT stops ordinary processing for immediate model preservation and dual graph verification. Any LIMIT, producer error, checker rejection, hash drift, transcript mismatch, disk-floor breach, or global wall-stop breach makes its entire shard uncertified.
Only fully generated and independently replayed shards count toward a certified tranche; partial bundles never count.
scope_warning: A replayed UNSAT tree certifies only its selected fixed induced 41-vertex core. Even exact replay of all 13776 pairs would not imply global order-43 nonexistence or change a Ramsey bound.
